data.desc: Graham Media Group is a local media company dedicated to informing and celebrating the communities it serves. The company is made up of seven local media outlets - KPRC ( Houston ), WDIV ( Detroit ), WSLS ( Roanoke ), KSAT ( San Antonio ), WKMG ( Orlando ), WJXT ( Jacksonville ), and WCWJ ( Jacksonville ) - along with Graham Digital, Omne, and Social News Desk, delivering local news, programming, advertising solutions, and digital media tools across television, online, mobile, streaming, podcasts, and audio devices. Headquartered in Detroit, Graham Media Group is a subsidiary of Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC). Learn more at www.grahammedia.com.
